releases.title: PXA Designer 1.0
releases.summary: The first versioned PXA Designer release brings authenticated visual document authoring, persistent templates, PDF and spreadsheet workflows, migration tools, localization, and operational feedback into one workspace.

added: Versioned release notes and product build information.
Central feature maturity metadata for Alpha, Beta, and Stable capabilities.
A notification center for releases and important account or system events.
Global, accessible feedback toasts for Designer actions.
improved: Designer navigation, authentication, template persistence, localization, and scrollable editing workflows.
security: Feature preferences and notifications are evaluated in the authenticated user and organization context.
